dataset: SkillShift AI six-career source-separated AI exposure evidence

ilo.title: Gmyrek et al. 2025 ILO Working Paper 140 / authors dataset
ilo.adaptation_notice: This is an adaptation of copyrighted ILO material; it has not been prepared, reviewed or endorsed by the ILO.

oecd.mapping_note: Existing verified mapping retained; US occupation evidence, not an official MASCO-O*NET crosswalk.
oecd.interpretation: Higher reversed normalized index indicates smaller AI capability gap; not job displacement or a Malaysia-specific rate.

ilo.measurement: Potential exposure of occupational tasks to generative AI, not predicted job loss.
ilo.occupation_mean_score_status: Not in the provided 4digits_with_tasks.xlsx; do not calculate or label a published mean from this file.

malaysian_context.evidence_note: Low AI impact is based on TalentCorp's Software Engineer classification, not an independently calculated prediction.
malaysian_context.occupation_mapping_note: Malaysian Software Developers (MASCO 2512) mapped to TalentCorp ICT Software Engineer and ESCO software developer (ISCO 2512). These occupation records are not identical.

limitations: The OECD, ILO and TalentCorp assessments use different methods and cannot be averaged.
AI capability overlap and GenAI exposure are not job replacement probabilities.
International occupational evidence is not a measured Malaysian employment or AI-adoption rate.
